en: Canyon trail - watch your step at dusk!
No quests yet - explore the canyon!
Gather 4 wood logs to light the campfire.
Craft a stone axe (2 stones and 1 log) from the journal.
Craft a hunting bow (3 logs) from the journal.
Build a shelter (8 logs and 4 stones) to get through the night.
Press M or the Close button
Ground too steep to build here.
Too many structures in the canyon.
You're not sleepy: wait for night.
You sleep until dawn. Stamina restored.
Shoot a deer with your bow to gather raw meat.
Cook raw meat on a full campfire.
The spring needs time to refill...
You need an equipped axe to chop this tree.
You need an equipped sickle to pick these berries.
Out of arrows! Craft some from the journal.
Axe equipped: get close to a tree and act to chop it.
Sickle equipped: get close to a berry bush to pick the berries.
Bow equipped: aim at an animal and press Shoot (left click).
Equip the axe (tool bar) and fell 3 trees: get close and act several times.
Craft a sickle from the journal (level 2 required).
Equip the sickle and pick 6 berries from the red bushes.
You need an equipped hoe to work the soil.
You need seeds (pick berries to find some).
Seed sown: the harvest will be ready in a few minutes.
You need an equipped sickle to shear.
Hoe equipped: get close to a placed plot to sow your seeds.
Craft a hoe from the journal (level 3 required).
Craft a farm plot and place it from the bag (Bag tab, Place button).
Equip the hoe, sow seeds on the plot, wait for them to grow and harvest 4 vegetables.
Feed a chicken, sheep, cow or goat (vegetables, berries or seeds) until it is tamed.
Collect milk, wool (with the sickle) or eggs 3 times from your tamed animals.
Offer meat to a stray dog until it is tamed (level 3 required). It follows you and improves your hunting.
Tame a horse with vegetables or berries (level 5 required), then ride it.
